snippet.title: Stellar Shipyard - Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Stellar Shipyard is a space colony sandbox where you design modular ships and stations, and automate resource production using drones and workers. Let the automated systems fly even the most improvised designs. Face rival factions and threats solo, or alongside friends as allies or rivals.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601670?utm_source=yt
